objective: Stop tab-switch Connect white screens by retaining its single mounted VirtualizedList, contain render exceptions with a recovery path, and retain genuine AdMob ad opportunities; distinguish provider no-fill.
productionBaselineEvidence: Inspected exact Main source 2bed08b8b8e1b26c8653f727d7324ecace6a333e on 2026-11-01. Screenshot shows all-white Connect after button taps and a blank Personal ad placeholder. Supabase Android operational events during preceding 16h: connect_personal_first_view 3 requests/2 genuine AdMob no-fill; profile_native_sponsored 7 loaded/6 impressions; several Cluster placements show fills. Exact native crash mechanism and production OTA source not independently established.
chosenApproach: Keep one FlatList mounted while data/filter tab changes, disable clipping during native view recycling, and introduce a scoped React render error boundary for Connect inbox and both thread routes; preserve Android ad SDK request architecture, banner and sponsored footer.
selectionRationale: Small coordinated navigation change avoids destroying the NativeAd, SDK banner and appearance modal every time Personal/Cluster/Org/Requests changes. Catching React render exceptions provides actionable recovery/signature but does not claim to catch native crashes. Existing no-fill and request cooldowns are provider-safe and must not be removed.
alternativeApproaches: Add aggressive AdMob retries on each tab/button tap: rejected; can create no-fill request storms and policy risks without increasing ad inventory.
Replace all chat and tabs with a new navigator: rejected; changes many non-target functions and risks unread, scopes and calls.
Keep one FlatList and a scoped render boundary while preserving native ad guards: selected.
preserveBehaviors: Personal/Cluster/Org/Requests selection, search, unread count, and scoped room identity
Personal and Community first-view banner placements plus scoped native sponsored footer
AdMob unit IDs, consent, network gating, SDK auto refresh, no-fill and shared cooldown unchanged
Unrelated feeds, photos/videos, calls, chat content, authentication and session isolation untouched
No new native dependency or Android runtime change; no OTA or production server edits
acceptanceChecks: Engineering Accountability correctly identifies Connect risk and runs changed runnable Node tests
TypeScript, Main integration and performance CI pass for exact DEV source SHA
One mounted FlatList under tab switches with no blank Connect renderer on React exceptions
Personal and Cluster/Org banner ad opportunity preserved without synthetic impressions
